title: Symbol layer
subtitle: All your punctuation in one place
description:
Adds a **Symbol** layer with your punctuation and brackets in one place, plus a key that types `..` in one press.

The **Symbol layer: language** automations (German, French, UK, Swedish) need this layer to exist first.
script:
# ==============================================================================
# Symbol layer
#
# Adds a layer called "Symbol" with punctuation and brackets, and one macro,
# &symb_dotdot_v1_TKZ, that types ".." in one press. Then, if the base layer's
# right thumb key is a plain key press, it becomes a layer-tap: tap it for the
# same key, hold it for the Symbol layer. Any other key there is left alone.
# Nothing else is touched. The "Symbol layer: language" automations translate this layer.
# ==============================================================================

# Limits and fixed names. MAX_LAYERS is the layout schema's layer limit (schemas/*.json).
def MAX_LAYERS: 32;
"Symbol" as $layerName
| "&symb_dotdot_v1_TKZ" as $macroName

# Key background colors, by what the key does.
| "#fbe6fe" as $pink      # quotes, backtick, tilde
| "#fffec9" as $yellow    # shifted number-row symbols
| "#e0ebf6" as $blue      # brackets
| "#d9f9c9" as $green     # other punctuation
| "#f8e6d7" as $brown     # editing keys
| "#e5feff" as $cyan      # underscore, plus, &, ..
| "#f2f2f2ff" as $grey    # sticky modifiers

# One key on the layer. Plain keys are key("A"; color); Shift+key is key(shift("N1"); color); a third argument is the label shown on the key.
| def shift($code): {value: "LS", params: [{value: $code}]};
  def code: if type == "string" then {value: .} else . end;
  def key($k; $bg): {value: "&kp", params: [$k | code], decoration: {background: $bg}};
  def key($k; $bg; $caption): {value: "&kp", params: [$k | code], decoration: {label: $caption, background: $bg}};
  def sticky($k; $bg): {value: "&sk", params: [$k | code], decoration: {background: $bg}};
  def none: {value: "&none"};
  def nones($n): [range($n) | none][];
  def dotdot($bg): {value: $macroName, decoration: {background: $bg}};
  def dotdot($bg; $caption): {value: $macroName, decoration: {label: $caption, background: $bg}};
  def fingerprint($bg): {value: "&none", decoration: {icon: "io-finger-print", color: "#ffffffff", background: $bg}};

# The two layers, key by key, in the keyboard's key order. Go60 has 60 typed keys; the
# last two positions of its 62 are left empty below so the layer is as long as the others.
def go60Layer: [
    key("GRAVE"; $pink), key("COMMA"; $yellow), key(shift("N9"); $blue), key(shift("N0"); $blue),
    key("SEMI"; $yellow), key("DOT"; $yellow), nones(6), key(shift("N1"); $pink),
    key("LBKT"; $blue), key(shift("LBKT"); $blue), key(shift("RBKT"); $blue), key("RBKT"; $blue),
    key(shift("FSLH"); $yellow), key("GRAVE"; $pink), key("DEL"; $brown), key(shift("TAB"); $brown),
    key("INS"; $brown), key("ESC"; $brown), none, key(shift("N3"); $yellow),
    key(shift("N6"); $yellow), key("EQUAL"; $green), key(shift("MINUS"); $brown), key(shift("N4"); $yellow),
    key(shift("N8"); $yellow), key(shift("SINGLE_QUOTE"); $pink), key("BSPC"; $brown), key("TAB"; $brown),
    key("SPACE"; $brown), key("RET"; $brown), none, key(shift("GRAVE"); $pink),
    key(shift("COMMA"); $green), key(shift("BSLH"); $green), key("MINUS"; $green), key(shift("DOT"); $green),
    key("FSLH"; $yellow), key("SQT"; $pink), sticky("LSHFT"; $grey), sticky("LCTRL"; $grey),
    sticky("LALT"; $grey), sticky("LGUI"; $grey), none, key("SQT"; $pink),
    key(shift("SINGLE_QUOTE"); $pink), key(shift("EQUAL"); $brown), key("BSLH"; $yellow), key(shift("N7"); $yellow),
    dotdot($yellow), key(shift("N5"); $yellow), key(shift("SEMI"); $yellow), key(shift("N2"); $yellow),
    nones(2), fingerprint("#000000ff")
];

def glove80Layer: [
    nones(10), key("GRAVE"; $pink), key(shift("N6"); $yellow; "^"), key(shift("N9"); $blue; "("),
    key(shift("N0"); $blue; ")"), key("SEMI"; $green), key("COMMA"; $green), nones(6),
    key(shift("N1"); $pink; "!"), key("LBKT"; $blue), key(shift("LBKT"); $blue; "{"), key(shift("RBKT"); $blue; "}"),
    key("RBKT"; $blue), key(shift("FSLH"); $yellow; "?"), key("DOT"; $green; "."), key("DEL"; $brown),
    key(shift("TAB"); $brown; "Shift Tab"), key("INS"; $brown), key("ESC"; $brown), none,
    key(shift("N3"); $yellow; "#"), key(shift("N6"); $yellow; "^"), key("EQUAL"; $green), key(shift("MINUS"); $cyan; "_"),
    key(shift("N4"); $yellow; "$"), key(shift("N8"); $yellow; "*"), key("COMMA"; $green; ","), key("BSPC"; $brown),
    key("TAB"; $brown), key("SPACE"; $brown), key("RET"; $brown), none,
    key(shift("GRAVE"); $pink; "~"), key(shift("COMMA"); $green; "<"), key(shift("BSLH"); $green; "|"), key("MINUS"; $green),
    key(shift("DOT"); $green; ">"), key("FSLH"; $yellow), key("BSLH"; $pink), key("DOT"; $green; "."),
    key(shift("N8"); $yellow; "*"), nones(3), key("SEMI"; $green; ";"), key(shift("SINGLE_QUOTE"); $pink; "\""),
    key("SQT"; $pink; "'"), key("GRAVE"; $pink; "`"), key("BSLH"; $pink), none,
    dotdot($cyan; ".."), key(shift("N7"); $cyan; "&"), key("SQT"; $pink), key(shift("SINGLE_QUOTE"); $pink; "\""),
    key(shift("EQUAL"); $cyan; "+"), key(shift("N5"); $yellow; "%"), key(shift("SEMI"); $yellow; ":"), key(shift("N2"); $yellow; "@"),
    nones(2), fingerprint("#000000fc"), sticky("RSHFT"; $grey), sticky("RCTRL"; $grey),
    sticky("RALT"; $grey), sticky("RGUI"; $grey), none
];

# The macro: tap "." twice.
def dotDotMacro: {name: $macroName, description: "Symbol layer dot dot", waitMs: 0, tapMs: 0, bindings: [{value: "&macro_tap"}, {value: "&kp", params: [{value: "DOT"}]}, {value: "&kp", params: [{value: "DOT"}]}], params: []};

# The base layer position of the right thumb key that becomes the layer-tap, per keyboard.
def thumbKeyAt($keyboard): if $keyboard == "glove80" then 74 else 59 end;

# Every behavior name in the layout, whichever list it lives in (names must be unique across all of them).
def behaviorNames: [(.macros, .holdTaps, .tapDances, .modMorphs, .stickyKeys)[]? | .name];

(.keyboard? | if type == "string" then ascii_downcase else "glove80" end) as $kb
| (.keymap // .) as $km
| if ($km | type) != "object" or ($km.layers | type) != "array" or ($km.layers | length) == 0 then error("This file has no layers, so there is nothing to add the Symbol layer to.")
  elif ($km.layer_names // [] | index($layerName)) != null then error("A layer named \"\($layerName)\" already exists, so nothing was added. Rename or remove it first.")
  elif ($km.layers[0] | length) as $n | (if $kb == "go60" then ($n != 60 and $n != 62) else $n != 80 end) then error("The first layer has \($km.layers[0] | length) keys, but the \(if $kb == "go60" then "Go60 has 60 keys (plus 2 touchpad positions)" else "Glove80 has 80" end).")
  elif ($km.layers | length) >= MAX_LAYERS then error("Your layout already has \($km.layers | length) layers and the limit is \(MAX_LAYERS). Remove a layer first.")
  elif ($km | behaviorNames | index($macroName)) != null and ($km.macros // [] | map(.name) | index($macroName)) == null then error("A behavior named \($macroName) already exists and is not a macro. Rename it first.")
  else . end

| ($km.layers[0] | length) as $keyCount
| ((if $kb == "go60" then go60Layer else glove80Layer end) as $keys | $keys + [range([$keyCount - ($keys | length), 0] | max) | none]) as $newLayer
| ($km.macros // [] | map(.name) | index($macroName) != null) as $macroExisted
| thumbKeyAt($kb) as $thumbAt
| $km.layers[0][$thumbAt] as $thumb
| ($thumb.value == "&kp" and ($thumb.params // []) != []) as $upgradeThumb

| (.keymap // .) |= (
    (if $macroExisted then . else .macros = ((.macros // []) + [dotDotMacro]) end)
    | .layer_names = ((.layer_names // []) + [$layerName])
    | .layers = (.layers + [$newLayer])
    | if $upgradeThumb then
        .layers[0][$thumbAt] = ({value: "&lt", params: [{value: (.layer_names | index($layerName)), params: []}, $thumb.params[0]]}
                                + (if $thumb.decoration then {decoration: $thumb.decoration} else {} end))
      else . end
  )
| . + {_flowReport: {
    changed: true,
    lines: ([{ok: true, text: "Added the Symbol layer (layer \($km.layers | length + 1))"},
             {ok: true, text: (if $macroExisted then "Kept your existing macro \($macroName)" else "Added the macro \($macroName), which types .." end)}]
            + [if $upgradeThumb
               then {ok: true, text: "Base layer key \($thumbAt + 1) is now a layer-tap, hold it for Symbol"}
               else {ok: false, text: "Base layer key \($thumbAt + 1) is not a plain key, so it was left alone. Assign a key to switch to Symbol yourself."} end]),
    log: ["\($kb) layout, \($keyCount) keys per layer, \($newLayer | length) keys on the new layer",
          "macro \($macroName) \(if $macroExisted then "already existed" else "added" end)",
          "base layer key \($thumbAt + 1) was \($thumb.value // "missing")\(if $upgradeThumb then " and became &lt " + ($km.layers | length | tostring) else "" end)"]
  }}
successMessage: A new Symbol layer was added, plus a key that types `..`. If your right thumb key was a plain key press, it is now a layer-tap that holds into Symbol — otherwise assign a key to switch to that layer yourself. The Symbol layer: language automations need this layer to exist first.

title: AI assistant layer
subtitle: Shortcuts for working with AI tools
description:
Adds an **AI_Control** layer with ready-made shortcuts for working with AI assistants, plus matching keys on your **Lower** layer.

⚠️ Needs tap-dance, mod-morph and sticky-key support in the Layout Editor. Stops safely if you already have an AI_Control layer, and never overwrites an existing macro or behavior with the same name. **If you already have a layer called Lower, it is replaced** by the AI shortcuts, so run this on a layout where that is fine.
script:
def MAX_LAYERS: 32;
def names(f): [(.[f] // [])[] | .name];

# The macros the AI layer needs. A macro you already have under the same name is kept as it is.
def AI_MACROS: [
    {"name":"&ai_usage","description":"Zero-config AI: Usage","tapMs":15,"waitMs":15,"bindings":[{"value":"&ai_composer"},{"value":"&macro_tap"},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"FSLH"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"U"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"S"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"A"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"G"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"E"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"ENTER"}]}]},

    {"name":"&ai_claude_background","description":"Zero-config AI: Claude Background","tapMs":15,"waitMs":15,"bindings":[{"value":"&macro_tap"},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"LC","params":[{"value":"X"}]}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"LC","params":[{"value":"B"}]}]}]},
    {"name":"&ai_claude_btw","description":"Zero-config AI: Claude BTW","tapMs":15,"waitMs":15,"bindings":[{"value":"&ai_composer"},{"value":"&macro_tap"},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"FSLH"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"B"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"T"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"W"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"ENTER"}]}]},

    {"name":"&ai_codex_side","description":"Zero-config AI: Codex Side","tapMs":15,"waitMs":15,"bindings":[{"value":"&ai_composer"},{"value":"&macro_tap"},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"FSLH"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"S"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"I"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"D"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"E"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"ENTER"}]}]},

    {"name":"&ai_codex_fast","description":"Zero-config AI: Codex Fast","tapMs":15,"waitMs":15,"bindings":[{"value":"&ai_composer"},{"value":"&macro_tap"},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"FSLH"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"F"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"A"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"S"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"T"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"ENTER"}]}]},
    {"name":"&ai_claude_new","description":"Zero-config AI: New Claude","tapMs":15,"waitMs":15,"bindings":[{"value":"&ai_composer"},{"value":"&macro_tap"},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"FSLH"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"C"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"L"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"E"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"A"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"R"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"ENTER"}]}]},
    {"name":"&ai_permissions","description":"Zero-config AI: Permissions","tapMs":15,"waitMs":15,"bindings":[{"value":"&ai_composer"},{"value":"&macro_tap"},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"FSLH"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"P"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"E"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"R"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"M"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"I"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"S"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"S"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"I"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"O"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"N"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"S"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"ENTER"}]}]},

    {"name":"&ai_status","description":"Zero-config AI: Status","tapMs":15,"waitMs":15,"bindings":[{"value":"&ai_composer"},{"value":"&macro_tap"},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"FSLH"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"S"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"T"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"A"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"T"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"U"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"S"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"ENTER"}]}]},
    {"name":"&ai_claude_copy","description":"Zero-config AI: Claude Copy","tapMs":15,"waitMs":15,"bindings":[{"value":"&ai_composer"},{"value":"&macro_tap"},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"FSLH"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"C"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"O"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"P"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"Y"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"ENTER"}]}]},
    {"name":"&ai_resume","description":"Zero-config AI: Resume","tapMs":15,"waitMs":15,"bindings":[{"value":"&ai_composer"},{"value":"&macro_tap"},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"FSLH"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"R"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"E"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"S"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"U"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"M"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"E"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"ENTER"}]}]},
    {"name":"&ai_compact","description":"Zero-config AI: Compact","tapMs":15,"waitMs":15,"bindings":[{"value":"&ai_composer"},{"value":"&macro_tap"},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"FSLH"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"C"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"O"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"M"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"P"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"A"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"C"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"T"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"ENTER"}]}]},
    {"name":"&ai_diff","description":"Zero-config AI: Diff","tapMs":15,"waitMs":15,"bindings":[{"value":"&ai_composer"},{"value":"&macro_tap"},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"FSLH"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"D"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"I"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"F"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"F"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"ENTER"}]}]},
    {"name":"&ai_review","description":"Zero-config AI: Review","tapMs":15,"waitMs":15,"bindings":[{"value":"&ai_composer"},{"value":"&macro_tap"},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"FSLH"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"R"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"E"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"V"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"I"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"E"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"W"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"ENTER"}]}]},
    {"name":"&ai_plan","description":"Zero-config AI: Plan","tapMs":15,"waitMs":15,"bindings":[{"value":"&ai_composer"},{"value":"&macro_tap"},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"FSLH"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"P"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"L"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"A"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"N"}]},{"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"ENTER"}]}]},
    {"name":"&sticky_key_oneshot","description":"","tapMs":0,"waitMs":0,"bindings":[{"value":"&macro_tap"},{"value":"&macro_param_1to1"},{"value":"&sticky_key_quickrel","params":[{"value":"MACRO_PLACEHOLDER"}]}]}
  ];

# What the layout holds before the changes, to tell afterwards what was added and what was kept.
(if type == "object" and .keymap? then .keymap else . end) as $km
| {macros: ($km | names("macros")), sticky: ($km | names("stickyKeys")), holdTaps: ($km | names("holdTaps")),
   lowerExisted: ((($km.layer_names // []) | index("Lower")) != null)} as $before

| (if type == "object" and .keymap? then .keymap else . end) |= (

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. PRE-FLIGHT SAFETY CHECKS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # Check 1: Glove80 only
  (if (.keyboard | type == "string" and ascii_downcase == "glove80") | not then
    error("This automation is made for the Glove80 only.")
  else . end) |

  # Check 2: Stop if there is no layer list to add to
  (if (.layers | type) != "array" or (.layers | length) == 0 then
    error("This file has no layers, so there is nothing to add the AI layer to.")
  else . end) |

  # Check 3: Stop if the AI_Control layer already exists
  (if ((.layer_names // []) | index("AI_Control")) != null then
    error("Your layout already has a layer named AI_Control, so nothing was changed. Rename or remove it first.")
  else . end) |

  # Check 4: Room for the new layers. AI_Control is added, and Lower too when you have none.
  ((if ((.layer_names // []) | index("Lower")) != null then 1 else 2 end) as $new
   | if (.layers | length) + $new > MAX_LAYERS then
       error("The AI shortcuts need \($new) free layer\(if $new == 1 then "" else "s" end), and your layout has \(.layers | length) of the \(MAX_LAYERS) allowed. Remove a layer first.")
     else . end) |

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. BEHAVIOR INJECTIONS (Idempotent - Skips if already exists)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  
  # Inject Sticky Keys safely (This fixes the missing &sticky_key_quickrel error)
  .stickyKeys = ((.stickyKeys // []) + [
    { "name": "&sticky_key_quickrel", "description": "Quick Release Sticky Key", "releaseAfterMs": 500, "quickRelease": true, "lazy": false, "ignoreModifiers": true, "bindings": ["&kp"] }
  ] | unique_by(.name)) |

  # Inject HoldTaps safely
  .holdTaps = ((.holdTaps // []) + [
    { "name": "&sticky_key_modtap", "description": "", "flavor": "tap-preferred", "tappingTermMs": 250, "bindings": ["&kp", "&sticky_key_oneshot"] }
  ] | unique_by(.name)) |

  # Inject Macros safely
  .macros = ((.macros // []) + AI_MACROS | unique_by(.name)) |

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. LAYER INJECTIONS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  
  # A. 'Lower' Layer Logic: Update if exists, otherwise append
  (

# Determine Keyboard Type
((.keymap.layers[0] // .layers[0]) | if type == "array" then length else .bindings | length end) as $count |
(if .keyboard then .keyboard elif $count > 70 then "glove80" else "go60" end) as $kb_type |
(keyboards[$kb_type]) as $cfg |
(if $cfg == null then error("This automation supports the Glove80 and Go60, not \($kb_type).") else . end) |

# Load Selected Layout
(layouts[$layout_name]) as $layout |
(if $layout == null then error("There is no typing layout called \($layout_name).") else . end) |

# Build the Remap Dictionary (ID -> New Key)
(
  reduce range(0;36) as $i (
    {};
    if ($layout[$i] != "" and $cfg.ids[$i] != null)
    then . + {($cfg.ids[$i]): $layout[$i]}
    else . end
  )
) as $remap |

(
  (.layer_names // .keymap.layer_names // []) |
  to_entries |
  map(select(.value as $v | $excluded | map(ascii_downcase) | contains([$v | ascii_downcase]))) |
  map(.key)
) as $skip_list |

############################################
# 3. PROCESSING
############################################

def keysOf: if type == "array" then . else .bindings end;
(.keymap.layers // .layers) as $before |
(.layer_names // .keymap.layer_names // []) as $names |

(.keymap.layers // .layers) |= (
  to_entries | map(
    .key as $idx | .value as $layer |

    # Check if layer is eligible for remapping
    ($idx == 0 or ($all_layers and ([$skip_list[] == $idx] | any | not))) as $eligible |

    if $eligible then

      ($layer | if type == "array" then . else .bindings end) as $bindings |

      # Determine if layer is Alpha-Heavy (2+ alphas on HRM positions)
      ([
        $bindings | to_entries[] |
        select(.key|tostring as $k | $cfg.hrm | contains([$k])) |
        .value | .. | strings? | select(test("^[A-Z]$"))

      if ($idx == 0 or $is_alpha_layer) then

        def do_swap($pos):

    }}

title: Switch apps with one key
subtitle: One-key Alt-Tab or Cmd-Tab
description: Makes Alt-Tab (Windows, Linux) or Cmd-Tab (Mac) a single keypress. Pick your computer below. It adds one macro, **&AppSwitch** — assign it to any key or combo to start using it.
script:
# ==============================================================================
# Switch apps with one key
#
# Adds one macro, &AppSwitch: hold the switcher key ($system: Alt, or Cmd on a Mac),
# tap Tab (the switcher stays open while it is held), release it. Assign it to any key or combo. Nothing else is touched.
# If a behavior called &AppSwitch already exists, nothing is changed and the result
# screen says so. Existing macros are never changed.
# ==============================================================================

# A macro control step (&macro_press, &macro_tap, &macro_release) and a key step.
def step($name): {value: $name, params: []};
def key($behavior; $code): {value: $behavior, params: [{value: $code}]};

# $system is the "system" parameter: "alt" (Windows, Linux) or "cmd" (macOS).
def appSwitch($system):
  (if $system == "cmd" then {mod: "LGUI", label: "Cmd-Tab"} else {mod: "LALT", label: "Alt-Tab"} end) as $s
  | {
  name: "&AppSwitch",
  description: "\($s.label) App Switcher Macro",
  waitMs: 100,
  tapMs: 40,
  params: [],
  bindings: [
    step("&macro_press"), key("&kp"; $s.mod),
    step("&macro_tap"),   key("&kp"; "TAB"),
    step("&macro_tap"),   key("&sk"; $s.mod),
    step("&macro_release"), key("&kp"; $s.mod)
  ]
};

# Every behavior name in the layout, whichever list it lives in (names must be unique across all of them).
def behaviorNames: [(.macros, .holdTaps, .tapDances, .modMorphs, .stickyKeys)[]? | .name];

(.keymap // .) as $km
| if ($km | type) != "object" or ($km.layers | type) != "array" then error("This file has no layers, so there is nothing to add the macro to.") else . end
| if ($km | behaviorNames | index("&AppSwitch")) != null then
    if ($km.macros // [] | map(.name) | index("&AppSwitch")) != null
    then . + {_flowReport: {changed: false, message: "Your layout already has an &AppSwitch macro, so nothing was changed. Assign it to a key or combo to use it.", lines: [], log: ["&AppSwitch exists in the macros list"]}}
    else error("A behavior named &AppSwitch already exists in this layout and is not a macro. Rename it first, then run this again.") end
  else
    (.keymap // .) |= (.macros = ((.macros // []) + [appSwitch($system)]))
    | . + {_flowReport: {changed: true, lines: [{ok: true, text: "Added the &AppSwitch macro"}], log: ["added &AppSwitch (\($system)) with \(appSwitch($system).bindings | length) steps"]}}
  end

title: Auto-label and color keys
subtitle: Colors and shortcut labels by theme and OS
description:
Labels and colors your keys for you: a background color from your chosen theme, and a label for common shortcuts (Copy, Paste, Undo, Save, Find, browser shortcuts …) that knows the difference between Windows/Linux and macOS (⌘C vs Ctrl+C).

**What to change** controls what gets touched: colors and labels together, either one on its own, or strip both off. Arrow keys never get a label — the Layout Editor already shows them as arrows.
script:
# ==============================================================================
# Auto-label and color keys
#
# Params: $mode (colors_labels | colors | labels | remove), $os (win | mac), $theme.
# Colors the home row of the base layer and every shortcut in the table below (on all layers),
# and gives the shortcuts a short label. Keys that are neither are never touched.
# "remove" strips ALL decoration (colors, labels, icons) from every key. The result screen
# says how many keys changed; a run that would change nothing says so instead of "success".
# ==============================================================================

# --- 1. COLOR THEMES ---
# pinky..index color the home-row fingers; the others color the shortcut groups.

  engrammer: {pinky: "#ffcdd2", ring: "#bbdefb", middy: "#dcedc8", index: "#ffecb3",
              clipboard: "#ffecb3", app: "#ffcdd2", system: "#dcedc8", nav: "#bbdefb", select: "#e0ebf6", browser: "#fbe6fe"},

  nordic:    {pinky: "#eceff4", ring: "#d8dee9", middy: "#b3d4e0", index: "#a3c9c6",

        "&kp(__MOD__(G))": { icon: "fa-search-plus", label: "Next" },
        "&kp(__MOD__(LS(G)))": { icon: "fa-search-minus", label: "Prev" },
        
        "&kp(LG(SPACE))": { icon: "fa-search", label: "Spotlight", os: "mac" },
        "&kp(LG(S))": { icon: "fa-search", label: "Search", os: "win" },
        "&kp(LG(D))": { icon: "fa-desktop", label: "Desktop", os: "win" },

        "&kp(DOWN)": { label:  "" },
        "&kp(LEFT)": { label:  ""  },
        "&kp(RIGHT)": { label:  "" },
        "&kp(PG_UP)": { description: "Page Up" },
        "&kp(PG_DN)": { description: "Page Down" },

        "&kp(LG(LEFT))": { icon: "fa-step-backward", label: "Line Start", os: "mac" },

        "&kp(LA(LEFT))": { icon: "fa-angle-double-left", label: "Prev Word", os: "mac" },

        "&kp(LC(BSPC))": {  label: "Del Word", os: "win" },
        "&kp(LA(BSPC))": {  label: "Del Word", os: "mac" },
        "&kp(LG(BSPC))": {  label: "Del Line", os: "mac" }
      }
    },
    {
      bg: $pal.select,
      items: {
        "&kp(LS(HOME))": { icon: "fa-outdent", label: "Sel Start", os: "win" },
        "&kp(LS(LG(LEFT)))": { icon: "fa-outdent", label: "Sel Start", os: "mac" },
        "&kp(LS(END))": { icon: "fa-indent", label: "Sel End", os: "win" },
        "&kp(LS(LG(RIGHT)))": { icon: "fa-indent", label: "Sel End", os: "mac" },
        
        "&kp(LS(LC(HOME)))": { icon: "fa-level-up-alt", label: "Sel Top", os: "win" },
        "&kp(LS(LG(UP)))": { icon: "fa-level-up-alt", label: "Sel Top", os: "mac" },
        "&kp(LS(LC(END)))": { icon: "fa-level-down-alt", label: "Sel Bottom", os: "win" },
        "&kp(LS(LG(DOWN)))": { icon: "fa-level-down-alt", label: "Sel Bottom", os: "mac" },

        "&kp(LS(LC(LEFT)))": { icon: "fa-angle-left", label: "Sel Prev", os: "win" },
        "&kp(LS(LA(LEFT)))": { icon: "fa-angle-left", label: "Sel Prev", os: "mac" },
        "&kp(LS(LC(RIGHT)))": { icon: "fa-angle-right", label: "Sel Next", os: "win" },
        "&kp(LS(LA(RIGHT)))": { icon: "fa-angle-right", label: "Sel Next", os: "mac" }
      }
    },
    {
      bg: $pal.browser,
      items: {
        "&kp(__MOD__(L))": { icon: "fa-link", label: "Focus URL" },
        "&kp(__MOD__(T))": { icon: "fa-plus-square", label: "New Tab" },
        "&kp(LS(__MOD__(T)))": { icon: "fa-history", label: "Reopen Tab" },
        "&kp(LC(TAB))": { icon: "fa-chevron-right", label: "Next Tab" },
        "&kp(LS(LC(TAB)))": { icon: "fa-chevron-left", label: "Prev Tab" },
        "&kp(__MOD__(R))": { icon: "fa-sync", label: "Refresh" },
        "&kp(LS(__MOD__(R)))": { icon: "fa-sync-alt", label: "Hard Refresh" },
        "&kp(LC(F5))": { icon: "fa-sync-alt", label: "Hard Refresh", os: "win" }
      }
    }
  ] 
  | map(.bg as $bg | .items | with_entries(
      select(.value.os == null or .value.os == "both" or .value.os == $os) |
      .key |= (split("__MOD__") | join($mod)) | 
      .value.background = $bg |
      .value |= del(.os)
    )) 
  | add
) as $logical_map |

# =========================================================
# ENGINE
# =========================================================

(.keyboard? | if type == "string" then ascii_downcase else "glove80" end) as $kb |

# --- HOME ROW ---
# Base-layer key positions of the eight home-row keys: left pinky to left index, then right index to right pinky.
({glove80: [35, 36, 37, 38, 41, 42, 43, 44], go60: [25, 26, 27, 28, 31, 32, 33, 34]}[$kb] // []) as $homePositions |
# On a Mac the pinky and middle colors are swapped.
(if $os == "mac" then {pinky: "middy", middy: "pinky"} else {} end) as $swap |
def homeStyle($finger; $icon): {background: $pal[$swap[$finger] // $finger], icon: $icon};
([("pinky", "ring", "middy", "index") | homeStyle(.; "fa-align-left")] + [("index", "middy", "ring", "pinky") | homeStyle(.; "fa-align-right")]) as $homeStyles |
([range($homePositions | length) as $i | {key: ($homePositions[$i] | tostring), value: $homeStyles[$i]}] | from_entries) as $homeRow |

(.keymap // .) as $km |
if ($km | type) != "object" or ($km.layers | type) != "array" or ($km.layers | length) == 0
then error("This file has no layers, so there are no keys to work on.") else . end |

# The troubleshooting log lists this many changed keys one by one; the rest are only counted.
def LOG_KEYS: 200;

# --- ONE KEY ---
# The text a binding is looked up by: "&kp(LC(C))", "&mt(LSHFT,A)", or just the text of a plain string.
def signature:
  if type == "object" and .value != null then
    (.params // []) as $p
    | (.value | tostring) + (if ($p | length) > 0 then "(" + ($p | map(signature) | join(",")) + ")" else "" end)
  else tostring end;

# A style with an icon but no label of its own takes the label from the key itself (its second parameter, or the first).
def labelFor($style):
  if $style.icon != null and ($style.label == null or $style.label == "") and type == "object" then
    (.params // []) as $p
    | if ($p | length) > 1 then ($p[1] | if type == "object" then (.value // .) else . end | tostring)
      elif ($p | length) > 0 then ($p[0] | if type == "object" then (.value // .) else . end | tostring)
      else $style.label end
  else $style.label end;

# The decoration to write for a style. "colors" never writes label/description (so it keeps labels you typed or
# an earlier labels run set); "labels" never writes background/color/icon; "colors_labels" writes it all.
def payload($style):
  ({background: $style.background, color: $style.color, icon: $style.icon, description: $style.description, label: labelFor($style)}
   | with_entries(select(.value != null)))
  | if $mode == "colors" then del(.label, .description)
    elif $mode == "labels" then del(.background, .color, .icon)
    else . end;

# Shortcuts win over the home-row color, which only exists on the base layer ($layerIdx == 0).
# Gives the key back with whether it changed: {key, changed}. Only styled keys are compared.
def decorate($layerIdx; $keyIdx):
  # Every shortcut in the table is a &kp, so other keys skip the lookup.
  ((if type == "object" and .value == "&kp" then $logical_map[signature] else null end)
   // (if $layerIdx == 0 then $homeRow[$keyIdx | tostring] else null end)) as $style
  | if $style == null then {key: ., changed: false}
    else . as $old
      | payload($style) as $new
      | (if type == "object" then .decoration = ((.decoration // {}) + $new)
         else {value: ., params: [], decoration: $new} end) as $key
      | {key: $key, changed: ($key != $old)}
    end;

$km.layers as $before
| (if $mode == "remove" then
    # Removing takes the whole decoration off every key that has one.
    [$before[] | map(if type == "object" then del(.decoration) else . end)] as $after
    | {after: $after, changed: [range($before | length) as $l | range($before[$l] | length) as $k | select($before[$l][$k] | type == "object" and has("decoration")) | [$l, $k]]}
  else
    [range($before | length) as $l | $before[$l] | . as $layer | [range(length) as $k | $layer[$k] | decorate($l; $k)]] as $results
    | {after: [$results[] | map(.key)], changed: [range($results | length) as $l | range($results[$l] | length) as $k | select($results[$l][$k].changed) | [$l, $k]]}
  end) as $done
| $done.after as $after
| $done.changed as $changed
| (reduce $changed[] as $c ([]; .[$c[0]] += 1)) as $perLayer
| ($km.layer_names // []) as $names
| def layerName($l): $names[$l] // "Layer \($l + 1)";
  def describe($d): if $d == null then "no decoration" else ([$d | to_entries[] | "\(.key) \(.value)"] | join(", ")) end;

if ($changed | length) == 0
then . + {_flowReport: {changed: false, message: (if $mode == "remove" then "None of your keys had a color or label, so nothing was changed." else "Every matching key already looks like this, or no key matches, so nothing was changed." end), lines: [], log: ["0 of \($before | map(length) | add) keys changed"]}}
else
  (.keymap // .) |= (.layers = $after)
  | . + {_flowReport: {
      changed: true,
      message: (if $mode == "remove" then "Removed the colors and labels from \($changed | length) keys." else "Colored or labeled \($changed | length) keys." end),
      lines: [range($perLayer | length) as $l | select($perLayer[$l] != null) | {ok: true, text: "\(layerName($l)): \($perLayer[$l]) keys"}],
      log: (["mode \($mode), \($os), theme \($theme), \($kb) layout", "\($changed | length) of \($before | map(length) | add) keys changed on \($changed | map(.[0]) | unique | length) of \($before | length) layers"]
            + [$changed[:LOG_KEYS][] | "\(layerName(.[0])) key \(.[1] + 1): \(describe($before[.[0]][.[1]].decoration?)) -> \(describe($after[.[0]][.[1]].decoration?))"]
            + (if ($changed | length) > LOG_KEYS then ["... and \($changed | length - LOG_KEYS) more keys"] else [] end))
    }}
end
successMessage: Your keys now have the colors and labels you chose: home-row keys on the base layer, and common shortcuts (copy, paste, navigation, browser …) on every layer, worded for macOS or Windows/Linux as you picked. To take them off again, run this with "What to change" set to Remove Decorators.

title: Capital letters on hold
subtitle: Autoshift: hold a letter to Shift it
description:
Hold any letter a moment longer to get the capital: tap for **a**, hold for **A**. [Watch a quick demo](https://youtu.be/S9MSCUjT1MA).

⚠️ Adds a new **Autoshift** layer right after your base layer, but it does nothing until you switch to it — assign a key to switch layers, or make Autoshift your base layer.
script:
# ==============================================================================
# 1. HELPERS
# ==============================================================================

def AUTOSHIFT_LAYER: "Autoshift";
def MAX_LAYERS: 32;

# Is this key a plain letter or number key (&kp A ... &kp Z, &kp N0 ... &kp N9)?
def is_autoshift_candidate($val):
  ($val | type == "string") and (
    ($val | test("^[A-Z]$")) or      # Alpha keys
    ($val | test("^N[0-9]$"))        # Number row (N1, N2, etc.)
  );

# The Autoshift version of one key of the first layer: letters and numbers get the
# Autoshift behavior, every other key is transparent so the layer below shows through.
def autoshift_key:
  . as $k
  | (if type == "object" then (.params[0].value // "") else "" end) as $val
  | if type == "object" and $k.value == "&kp" and is_autoshift_candidate($val) then
      { "value": "&AS_v1_TKZ",
        "params": [{ "value": $val, "params": ($k.params[0].params // []) }] }
    else
      { "value": "&trans", "params": [] }
    end;

# Adds the items whose name is not in the list yet. Items you already have with the same
# name are kept as they are (TailorKey layouts bring their own copies), in your order.
def add_missing($new):
  (. // []) as $have
  | $have + ($new | map(select(.name as $n | ($have | map(.name) | index($n)) == null)));

# --- Moving layer numbers when the Autoshift layer is inserted after the base layer ---
# Layer keys are the ZMK ones (mo, to, tog, sl, lt), your own hold-taps that start with one of them,
# and macros that pass one of their own parameters to one of them. Name -> positions of the layer number.
def layer_params:
  . as $km
  | {"mo": [0], "to": [0], "tog": [0], "sl": [0], "lt": [0]} as $zmk
  | reduce (($km.holdTaps // [])[] | select(.name != null)) as $h ($zmk;
      ([($h.bindings // []) | to_entries[] | select(.value | ltrimstr("&") | IN("mo", "to", "tog", "sl", "lt")) | .key]) as $at
      | if ($at | length) > 0 then .[$h.name | ltrimstr("&")] = $at else . end)
  | reduce (($km.macros // [])[] | select(.name != null)) as $m (.;
      ([range(0; (($m.bindings // []) | length) - 1) as $i
        | $m.bindings[$i] as $a | $m.bindings[$i + 1] as $b
        | select(($a.value // "") | startswith("&macro_param_"))
        | select(($b.value // "") | ltrimstr("&") | IN("mo", "to", "tog", "sl", "lt"))
        | (($a.value | ltrimstr("&macro_param_") | .[0:1] | tonumber) - 1)] | unique) as $at
      | if ($at | length) > 0 then .[$m.name | ltrimstr("&")] = $at else . end);

# Layer numbers are usually numbers, but some layouts store them as text ("2").
def shiftUp($n):
  if type == "number" then (if . >= 1 then . + $n else . end)
  elif type == "string" and test("^[0-9]+$") then (tonumber | (if . >= 1 then . + $n else . end) | tostring)
  else . end;

# Moves the layer number of every layer key anywhere in the file (see layer_params above). $lp says where the layer number sits.
def moveRefs($lp; f):
  reduce path(..
      | select(type == "object" and (.value | type) == "string" and (.params | type) == "array" and $lp[.value | ltrimstr("&")] != null)) as $p
    (.; (getpath($p).value | ltrimstr("&")) as $name
      | reduce $lp[$name][] as $i (.;
          if (getpath($p + ["params", $i]) | type) == "object" and (getpath($p + ["params", $i]) | has("value"))
          then setpath($p + ["params", $i, "value"]; getpath($p + ["params", $i, "value"]) | f) else . end));

def shift_refs($n):
  layer_params as $lp
  | moveRefs($lp; shiftUp($n))
  | .combos[]? |= (if (.layers | type) == "array" then .layers |= map(shiftUp($n)) else . end)
  | .inputListeners[]?.nodes[]? |= (if (.layers | type) == "array" then .layers |= map(shiftUp($n)) else . end);

# ==============================================================================
# 2. BEHAVIOR DEFINITIONS
# ==============================================================================

def get_as_macros: [
  {
    "name": "&AS_Shifted_v1_TKZ",
    "description": "AutoShift: Shifted State",
    "bindings": [
      {"value":"&macro_press","params":[]},
      {"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"LSHFT","params":[]}]},
      {"value":"&macro_tap","params":[]},
      {"value":"&macro_param_1to1","params":[]},
      {"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"N1","params":[]}]},
      {"value":"&macro_release","params":[]},
      {"value":"&kp","params":[{"value":"LSHFT","params":[]}]}
    ],
    "params": ["code"]
  },
  {
    "name": "&AS_v1_TKZ",
    "description": "AutoShift: Main Entry",
    "waitMs": 10, "tapMs": 10,
    "bindings": [
      {"value":"&macro_press","params":[]},
      {"value":"&macro_param_1to1","params":[]},
      {"value":"&macro_param_1to2","params":[]},
      {"value":"&AS_HT_v2_TKZ","params":[{"value":"A","params":[]},{"value":"A","params":[]}]},
      {"value":"&macro_pause_for_release","params":[]},
      {"value":"&macro_release","params":[]},
      {"value":"&macro_param_1to1","params":[]},
      {"value":"&macro_param_1to2","params":[]},
      {"value":"&AS_HT_v2_TKZ","params":[{"value":"A","params":[]},{"value":"A","params":[]}]}
    ],
    "params": ["code"]
  }
];

def get_as_holdtap: {
  "name": "&AS_HT_v2_TKZ",
  "description": "AutoShift: Engine",
  "bindings": ["&AS_Shifted_v1_TKZ", "&kp"],
  "tappingTermMs": 190,
  "flavor": "tap-preferred"
};

# ==============================================================================
# 3. MAIN ENGINE
# ==============================================================================

# The layout as it is now, to tell afterwards what changed.
(if type == "object" and .keymap? then .keymap else . end) as $before |

(.keymap // .) |= (

  # --- CHECKS: stop before changing anything ---
  (if (.layers | type) != "array" or (.layers | length) == 0
   then error("This file has no layers, so there is nothing to base the Autoshift layer on.")
   else . end) |
  ((.layer_names // []) | index(AUTOSHIFT_LAYER)) as $existing_idx |
  (if ((.layer_names // []) | length) != (.layers | length)
   then error("The layer names and the layers of this file do not match, so it can't be changed safely.")
   else . end) |
  (if $existing_idx == null and (.layers | length) >= MAX_LAYERS
   then error("The Autoshift layer needs one free layer, and your layout already has all \(MAX_LAYERS) allowed. Remove a layer first.")
   else . end) |
  ([.layers[0][] | autoshift_key] | map(select(.value != "&trans"))) as $shifting |
  (if ($shifting | length) == 0
   then error("Your first layer has no plain letter or number keys, so Autoshift has nothing to work on. Keys that already do something extra when held, such as home row mods, are left out.")
   else . end) |

  # --- BEHAVIORS: added only when you do not have them yet ---
  .macros = ((.macros // []) | add_missing(get_as_macros)) |
  .holdTaps = ((.holdTaps // []) | add_missing([get_as_holdtap])) |

  # --- LAYER: rebuilt in place when you already have one, otherwise added right after the first layer ---
  # (every layer after the first one moves up by 1, and so does every key that points at one)
  (if $existing_idx == null then shift_refs(1) else . end) |
  ($existing_idx // 1) as $as_idx |
  .layer_names = (if $existing_idx == null then [.layer_names[0], AUTOSHIFT_LAYER] + .layer_names[1:] else .layer_names end) |
  (if $existing_idx == null
   then .layers = [.layers[0], [.layers[0][] | autoshift_key]] + .layers[1:]
   else .layers[$as_idx] = [.layers[0][] | autoshift_key] end)
)

# --- REPORT ---
| (if type == "object" and .keymap? then .keymap else . end) as $after
| (($before.layer_names // []) | index(AUTOSHIFT_LAYER)) as $old_idx
| ((($after.macros // []) | length) - (($before.macros // []) | length)
   + (($after.holdTaps // []) | length) - (($before.holdTaps // []) | length)) as $added
| ($after.layers[$after.layer_names | index(AUTOSHIFT_LAYER)] | map(select(.value != "&trans")) | length) as $keys
| ([.custom_defined_behaviors, .custom_devicetree | select(type == "string" and test("\\S"))] | length > 0) as $hasCode
| if $before == $after then
    . + {_flowReport: {changed: false, message: "Nothing was changed: the Autoshift layer already matches your first layer.", lines: [], log: ["identical to the existing layer"]}}
  else
    . + {_flowReport: {
        changed: true,
        lines: ([(if $old_idx != null
                 then {ok: true, text: "Rebuilt your Autoshift layer (layer \($old_idx + 1)) from your first layer: \($keys) letter and number keys shift when held"}
                 else {ok: true, text: "Added the Autoshift layer (layer 2, right after your first layer): \($keys) letter and number keys shift when held"} end),
                {ok: true, text: (if $added > 0 then "Added \($added) behaviors that make it work" else "Your layout already had the behaviors Autoshift needs, so they were kept" end)}]
                + (if $old_idx == null and $hasCode then [{ok: false, text: "Your layout has custom code (Custom Defined Behaviors or Custom Devicetree). If it uses layer numbers instead of layer names, check them, because every layer after your first layer moved up by 1."}] else [] end)),
        log: ["layers: \($before.layers | length) before, \($after.layers | length) after", "behaviors added: \($added)"]
      }}
  end
successMessage: A new 'Autoshift' layer was added right after your base layer. It does nothing until you switch to it: assign a key that switches to that layer (layer-tap, toggle or momentary), or make Autoshift your base layer.

title: Underglow from key colors
subtitle: Per-key RGB lighting (PR36)
description:
Turns the colors you gave your keys into per-key RGB lighting for the PR36 community firmware. [Learn about PR36](https://sites.google.com/view/tailorkey/how-to/rgb).

- **Choose a style.** Screen colors look washed out on real LEDs, so "Bright colors" boosts them to look right on the keyboard. "Battery saver" lights one LED color per key.
- **Safe to run again.** The lighting is written between two marker lines in your Custom Devicetree, and a run again replaces only that part. Your own code there is kept. A key with a note starting with `no_rgb` stays dark, and a transparent key lets the layer below shine through.
- Colors that end up the same on the keyboard share one name, so the file stays small.
- The report warns you when your Custom Devicetree holds other per-key lighting code outside the marker lines, or several earlier lighting sections, because two lighting sections can clash when you build.
- **Lock-key indicators (optional).** The Caps, Num or Scroll Lock key lights up in the indicator color while that lock is on. They are placed on the key that presses the lock, on each layer where it is found. A lock set on a combo is not found.

After applying: in the Layout Editor choose the PR36 community firmware in Settings, build, flash, then do a configuration factory reset on the keyboard and pair Bluetooth again.
script:
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Underglow from key colors: writes a PR36 RGB scheme into Custom Devicetree.
#
# 1. Read the key colors (6-digit hex), black means unlit.
# 2. Convert each to the color the LED should show, depending on the chosen style.
# 3. Colors that end up identical share one name (C01, C02, ...).
# 4. Write one block per layer, between two marker lines. The markers are the same
#    ones the Kiilix editor uses, so both tools recognize each other's lighting.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def START: "// ==== PER-KEY-RGB <section begins> ====";
def END: "// ==== PER-KEY-RGB <section ends> ====";

# An older version of this automation wrote the block without markers.
def OLD_START: "#if __has_include(<dt-bindings/zmk/rgb_colors.h>)";
def OLD_END: "  #undef ___\n#endif";

# ---- Colors ----------------------------------------------------------------

# "#F80" or "#FF8800" or "#FF8800CC" as "FF8800"; "" for anything else.
def rgbHex:
  if type == "string" and test("^#([0-9A-Fa-f]{3}|[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}|[0-9A-Fa-f]{8})$") then
    (.[1:] | ascii_upcase) as $h
    | if ($h | length) == 3 then ($h | [.[0:1], .[0:1], .[1:2], .[1:2], .[2:3], .[2:3]] | join("")) else ($h | .[0:6]) end
  else "" end;

def hexByte: explode | map(if . >= 97 then . - 87 elif . >= 65 then . - 55 else . - 48 end) | .[0] * 16 + .[1];
def parseRgb: [.[0:2], .[2:4], .[4:6]] | map(hexByte);
def hex2: (. / 16 | floor) as $hi | (. - 16 * $hi) as $lo | "0123456789ABCDEF" | .[$hi:$hi + 1] + .[$lo:$lo + 1];
def toHex: map(hex2) | join("");

def clamp($lo; $hi): if . < $lo then $lo elif . > $hi then $hi else . end;
def cube: . * . * .;
def toLinear: . / 255 | if . <= 0.04045 then . / 12.92 else pow((. + 0.055) / 1.055; 2.4) end;
def fromLinear: clamp(0; 1) | if . <= 0.0031308 then . * 12.92 else 1.055 * pow(.; 1 / 2.4) - 0.055 end;
def toByte: . * 255 | round | clamp(0; 255);

# sRGB bytes to OKLab, the color space where "how colorful" can be changed without shifting the hue.
def toOklab:
  map(toLinear) as [$r, $g, $b]
  | ((0.412221469470763 * $r + 0.5363325372617348 * $g + 0.0514459932675022 * $b) | cbrt) as $l
  | ((0.2119034958178252 * $r + 0.6806995506452344 * $g + 0.1073969535369406 * $b) | cbrt) as $m
  | ((0.0883024591900564 * $r + 0.2817188391361215 * $g + 0.6299787016738222 * $b) | cbrt) as $s
  | [0.210454268309314 * $l + 0.7936177747023054 * $m - 0.0040720430116193 * $s,
     1.9779985324311684 * $l - 2.4285922420485799 * $m + 0.450593709617411 * $s,
     0.0259040424655478 * $l + 0.7827717124575296 * $m - 0.8086757549230774 * $s];

def fromOklab:
  . as [$L, $a, $b]
  | (($L + 0.3963377773761749 * $a + 0.2158037573099136 * $b) | cube) as $l
  | (($L - 0.1055613458156586 * $a - 0.0638541728258133 * $b) | cube) as $m
  | (($L - 0.0894841775298119 * $a - 1.2914855480370667 * $b) | cube) as $s
  | [4.0767416360759583 * $l - 3.3077115392580630 * $m + 0.2309699031821043 * $s,
     -1.2684379732850317 * $l + 2.6097573492876887 * $m - 0.3413193760026573 * $s,
     -0.0041960761386756 * $l - 0.7034186179359362 * $m + 1.7076146940746117 * $s]
  | map(fromLinear | toByte);

# "Bright colors": four times as colorful (but never beyond what an LED can show),
# then a gamma curve, because LEDs look much brighter than a screen at the same value.
def bright: toOklab as [$L, $a, $b]
  | ((($a * $a + $b * $b) | sqrt)) as $c
  | (if $c == 0 then 1 else ([$c * 4, 0.4] | min) / $c end) as $f
  | [$L, $a * $f, $b * $f] | fromOklab
  | map(. / 255 | pow(.; 3) | . * 255 | round);

# "Softer": switch off the weakest of the three LEDs, so at most two are lit.
def medium: (min) as $lowest | (index($lowest)) as $i | .[$i] = 0;

# "Battery saver": the strongest of red, green and blue only, or off for dark colors.
def eco:
  (max) as $top
  | if $top < 20 then [0, 0, 0]
    elif .[0] == $top then [255, 0, 0]
    elif .[1] == $top then [0, 255, 0]
    else [0, 0, 255] end;

# The editor color (hex) as the LED color (hex).
def ledColor($style):
  parseRgb
  | if $style == "bright" then bright
    elif $style == "medium" then medium
    elif $style == "eco" then eco
    else . end
  | toHex;

# Rough battery use of an LED color, 0 to 100.
def power: parseRgb | (.[0] * 0.30 + .[1] * 0.35 + .[2] * 0.35) / 255 * 100;

# ---- Keys ------------------------------------------------------------------

def noRgb:
  (.decoration?.description? // "") as $d
  | if ($d | type) == "string" then ($d | sub("^\\s+"; "") | ascii_downcase | startswith("no_rgb")) else false end;

# The name a key gets in the lighting layer: a color name, ___ (off) or _t_ (transparent).
def keyName($names):
  if noRgb then "___"
  else (.decoration?.background? | rgbHex) as $h
    | if $h != "" then ($names[$h] // "___")
      elif ((.value // "") | ascii_downcase) == "&trans" then "_t_"
      else "___" end
  end;

# Which lock a key switches, if any: "caps", "num" or "scroll". Only a plain key press counts;
# Caps Word does not change the lock state the keyboard LED reports, so it is not included.
def lockOf:
  if (.value // "") == "&kp" and ((.params // []) | length) == 1 and ((.params[0].params // []) | length) == 0
  then (.params[0].value // "") as $c
    | if ($c | IN("CAPS", "CAPSLOCK", "CLCK", "LCAPS", "LOCKING_CAPS")) then "caps"
      elif ($c | IN("KP_NUM", "KP_NUMLOCK", "KP_NLCK", "LNLCK", "LOCKING_NUM")) then "num"
      elif ($c | IN("SLCK", "SCROLLLOCK", "SCLK", "LSLCK", "LOCKING_SCROLL")) then "scroll"
      else null end
  else null end;

# ---- Writing into Custom Devicetree ------------------------------------------

# Everything after the end marker of one section.
def afterEnd: split(END) | .[1:] | join(END);

# Put $block where the earlier lighting was. Null when there is none to replace.
def replaceBlock($old; $block):
  ($old | split(START)) as $parts
  | if ($parts | length) > 1 then
      if ($parts[1:] | any(contains(END) | not)) then error("Your Custom Devicetree has a PER-KEY-RGB start line without its end line. Fix or remove it first.")
      else $parts[0] + $block + ($parts[1:] | map(afterEnd) | join(""))
      end
    else
      ($old | split(OLD_START)) as $legacy
      | if ($legacy | length) == 2 and ($legacy[1] | split(OLD_END) | length) == 2
        then $legacy[0] + $block + ($legacy[1] | split(OLD_END) | .[1])
        else null end
    end;

def setParam($name; $value):
  (.config_parameters // []) as $c
  | if ($c | map(.paramName) | index($name)) != null
    then .config_parameters = ($c | map(if .paramName == $name then .value = $value else . end))
    else .config_parameters = ($c + [{paramName: $name, value: $value}]) end;

# ---- Main --------------------------------------------------------------------

(if type == "object" and .keymap? then .keymap else . end) as $km
| if ($km | type) != "object" or ($km.layers | type) != "array" or ($km.layers | length) == 0
  then error("This file has no layers, so there are no key colors to read.")
  elif ($km.keyboard != "glove80" and $km.keyboard != "go60")
  then error("This automation supports the Glove80 and Go60, not \($km.keyboard // "an unknown keyboard").")
  else
    $km.keyboard as $kb
    | ($km.layer_names // []) as $names
    | (if $kb == "glove80" then 80 else 60 end) as $need

    # Lock-key indicators: the locks to show and the color they light up in
    | {caps: "BCL", num: "BNL", scroll: "BSL"} as $lockMacro
    | (if $lock_leds == "caps" then ["caps"] elif $lock_leds == "all" then ["caps", "num", "scroll"] else [] end) as $wanted
    | ($indicator_color | sub("^\\s*#?"; "") | sub("\\s+$"; "") | ascii_upcase) as $indHex
    | (if ($wanted | length) > 0 and ($indHex | test("^[0-9A-F]{6}$") | not)
       then error("The indicator color must be a 6-digit hex color such as 0000FF.") else . end)

    # 1. The distinct key colors in order of appearance, black (unlit) excluded
    | ([$km.layers[][] | (.decoration?.background? | rgbHex) | select(. != "" and . != "000000")]
       | reduce .[] as $c ([]; if index($c) != null then . else . + [$c] end)) as $colors
    | ([$km.layers[][] | (.decoration?.background? | rgbHex) | select(. != "" and . != "000000")] | length) as $coloredKeys
    | if ($colors | length) == 0
      then . + {_flowReport: {changed: false, message: "None of your keys has a color yet, so there is nothing to light up. Color some keys first, then run this again.", lines: [], log: ["no key backgrounds found"]}}
      else

    # 2. The LED color for each, and which editor colors end up the same
    ($colors | map({editor: ., led: ledColor($look)})
     | reduce .[] as $c ([];
         (map(.led) | index($c.led)) as $i
         | if $i == null then . + [{led: $c.led, editors: [$c.editor]}] else .[$i].editors += [$c.editor] end)) as $groups

    # 3. Give each LED color a short name: C01, C02, ... (a color that comes out black is off)
    | (reduce range(0; $groups | length) as $i ({n: 0, names: {}, led: {}};
        $groups[$i] as $g
        | if $g.led == "000000" then reduce $g.editors[] as $e (.; .names[$e] = "___")
          else .n += 1
            | ("C" + (.n | tostring | if length == 1 then "0" + . else . end)) as $id
            | (reduce $g.editors[] as $e (.; .names[$e] = $id))
            | .led[$id] = $g.led
          end)) as $naming
    | $naming.names as $colorNames

    # 4. One block per layer, laid out like the keyboard
    | ($km.layers | to_entries | map(
        .key as $idx
        | (($names)[$idx] // "Layer_\($idx)") as $layerName
        | (.value | length) as $keyCount
        | (if $keyCount < $need or ($kb == "glove80" and $keyCount != 80) or ($kb == "go60" and $keyCount != 60 and $keyCount != 62)
           then error("Layer \($layerName) has \($keyCount) keys, but the \(if $kb == "glove80" then "Glove80 has 80 keys" else "Go60 has 60 keys, plus 2 touchpad positions" end).")
           else . end)
        | (.value | map(keyName($colorNames))) as $base
        | (.value[0:$need] | map(lockOf)) as $locks
        | (reduce $wanted[] as $t ($base; ($locks | index($t)) as $p | if $p == null then . else .[$p] = $lockMacro[$t] end)) as $m
        | {name: $layerName, m: $m, ind: [$wanted[] | select(. as $t | ($locks | index($t)) != null)], blank: ($m | all(. == "_t_" or . == "___")),
           grid: (if $kb == "glove80" then
      "          \($m[0:5]|join(" "))                                             \($m[5:10]|join(" "))\n" +
      "          \($m[10:16]|join(" "))                                     \($m[16:22]|join(" "))\n" +
      "          \($m[22:28]|join(" "))                                     \($m[28:34]|join(" "))\n" +
      "          \($m[34:40]|join(" "))                                     \($m[40:46]|join(" "))\n" +
      "          \($m[46:52]|join(" "))     \($m[52:55]|join(" "))     \($m[55:58]|join(" "))     \($m[58:64]|join(" "))\n" +
      "          \($m[64:69]|join(" "))         \($m[69:72]|join(" "))     \($m[72:75]|join(" "))         \($m[75:80]|join(" "))"
    else
      "          \($m[0:6]|join(" "))                                     \($m[6:12]|join(" "))\n" +
      "          \($m[12:18]|join(" "))                                     \($m[18:24]|join(" "))\n" +
      "          \($m[24:30]|join(" "))                                     \($m[30:36]|join(" "))\n" +
      "          \($m[36:42]|join(" "))                                     \($m[42:48]|join(" "))\n" +
      "                  \($m[48:51]|join(" "))                                             \($m[51:54]|join(" "))\n" +
      "                                      \($m[54:57]|join(" "))     \($m[57:60]|join(" "))"
    end)}
      )) as $all
    | ($all | map(select(($which_layers == "all") or (.blank | not)))) as $written
    | if ($written | length) == 0
      then . + {_flowReport: {changed: false, message: "None of the keys that would be lit has a color (keys marked no_rgb stay dark), so there is nothing to write.", lines: [], log: ["no layer has a lit key"]}}
      else
    (if $fade_delay < 0 then "" else "\n        fade-delay = <\($fade_delay | floor)>;" end) as $fade
    | ($written | map("\n      #ifdef LAYER_\(.name)\n      \(.name) {\n        bindings = <\n\(.grid)\n        >;\n        layer-id = <LAYER_\(.name)>;\($fade)\n      };\n      #endif\n") | join("")) as $layersOutput
    | ($naming.led | to_entries) as $used
    | (["caps", "num", "scroll"] | map(select(. as $t | $written | any(.ind | index($t) != null)))) as $lockTypes
    | ({caps: "&ug_cl", num: "&ug_nl", scroll: "&ug_sl"}) as $lockFunc
    | ("  // ___ RGB Palette (Optimized & Deduplicated) ___\n"
       + ($used | map("  #define \(.key) &ug 0x\(.value)\n") | join(""))
       + "  #define _t_ &trans\n  #define ___ &ug 0x000000\n"
       + ($lockTypes | map("  #define \($lockMacro[.]) \($lockFunc[.]) 0x000000 0x\($indHex)\n") | join(""))) as $palette
    | ("  // ___ Cleanup ___\n" + ($used | map("  #undef \(.key)\n") | join("")) + "  #undef _t_\n  #undef ___\n"
       + ($lockTypes | map("  #undef \($lockMacro[.])\n") | join(""))) as $undef
    | (START + "\n" + OLD_START + "\n" + $palette
       + "  / {\n    underglow-layer {\n      compatible = \"zmk,underglow-layer\";\n"
       + $layersOutput + "    };\n  };\n" + $undef + "#endif\n" + END) as $block

    # 5. Merge into Custom Devicetree and set the firmware options
    | ($km.custom_devicetree // "") as $old
    | replaceBlock($old; $block) as $merged

    # Doubts worth telling the person about: several earlier sections, an old unmarked one, or lighting code of their own
    | (replaceBlock($old; "") // $old) as $outside
    | (($old | split(START) | length) - 1) as $oldSections
    | ($merged != null and $oldSections == 0) as $replacedUnmarked
    | ($outside | test("zmk,underglow-layer|underglow-layer\\s*\\{|rgb_colors\\.h")) as $otherLighting
    | (if $merged != null then $merged
       elif ($old | test("^\\s*$")) then $block
       else ($old | sub("\\s+$"; "")) + "\n\n" + $block end) as $new
    | ($km | .custom_devicetree = $new
       | setParam("EXPERIMENTAL_RGB_LAYER"; "y")
       | if $auto_off == "yes" then setParam("EXPERIMENTAL_RGB_UNDERGLOW_AUTO_OFF_IDLE"; "y")
         elif $auto_off == "no" then setParam("EXPERIMENTAL_RGB_UNDERGLOW_AUTO_OFF_IDLE"; "n")
         else . end) as $newKm

    # 6. Report
    | ([$written[].m[] | select(. != "___" and . != "_t_") | $naming.led[.] | select(. != null) | power]) as $powers
    | (if ($powers | length) == 0 then null else (($powers | add) / ($powers | length)) end) as $avg
    | if $newKm == $km
      then . + {_flowReport: {changed: false, message: "Nothing was changed: your Custom Devicetree already holds exactly this lighting.", lines: [], log: ["generated block identical to the existing one"]}}
      else
        ((if type == "object" and .keymap? then .keymap else . end) = $newKm)
        | . + {_flowReport: {
            changed: true,
            lines: [{ok: true, text: "Found \($colors | length) colors on \($coloredKeys) keys across \($km.layers | length) layers"},
                    {ok: true, text: (if ($used | length) < ($colors | length)
                                      then "Matched them to \($used | length) LED colors (\($colors | length) became \($used | length) because some looked the same on the keyboard)"
                                      else "Gave each of them its own LED color" end)},
                    {ok: true, text: "Wrote lighting for \($written | length) of \($all | length) layers\(if ($written | length) < ($all | length) then " (layers without colors were left out)" else "" end)"},
                    ($wanted[] as $t
                     | {caps: "Caps Lock", num: "Num Lock", scroll: "Scroll Lock"}[$t] as $lockName
                     | ([$written[] | select(.ind | index($t) != null) | .name]) as $on
                     | if ($on | length) > 0 then {ok: true, text: "\($lockName) indicator on the \($lockName) key of layer\(if ($on | length) > 1 then "s" else "" end) \($on | join(", "))"}
                       else {ok: false, text: "No \($lockName) key found on any layer, so there is no \($lockName) indicator (a lock set on a combo is not found)"} end),
                    (if $avg == null then empty
                     else {ok: true, text: "Estimated battery use of the lit keys: \(if $avg <= 35 then "LOW" elif $avg <= 70 then "MEDIUM" else "HIGH" end) (\($avg | round)% of full brightness on average)"} end),
                    {ok: true, text: (if $merged != null then "Replaced the lighting from an earlier run, the rest of your Custom Devicetree is untouched"
                                      elif ($old | test("^\\s*$")) then "Wrote the lighting into your empty Custom Devicetree"
                                      else "Added the lighting after your own Custom Devicetree code, which is untouched" end)},
                    (if $oldSections > 1 then {ok: false, text: "Your Custom Devicetree had \($oldSections) lighting sections from earlier runs. They were replaced by this one."} else empty end),
                    (if $replacedUnmarked then {ok: false, text: "Replaced a lighting section without marker lines, written by an older version. If you wrote that code yourself, check your Custom Devicetree."} else empty end),
                    (if $otherLighting then {ok: false, text: "Your Custom Devicetree also has other per-key lighting code outside the marker lines. Two lighting sections can clash when you build, so remove one of them."} else empty end),
                    {ok: true, text: "Turned on the RGB layer setting\(if $auto_off == "yes" then " and switching off when idle" elif $auto_off == "no" then " and keeping the lights on when idle" else "" end)"}],
            log: (["\($kb), style \($look), colors \($colors | join(" "))"]
                  + [$used[] | "\(.key) = \(.value)"]
                  + ["block \($block | split("\n") | length) lines, previous Custom Devicetree \($old | split("\n") | length) lines"])
          }}
      end
      end
    end
  end

title: Emoji layer
subtitle: 40 emoji on a layer
description:
Adds a 40-emoji layer for quick, expressive typing 😊❤️✅🔥.

script:
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ZMK UNICODE MACRO GENERATOR (Protocol v8.4 - UI Timings & Trans Padding)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Purpose: Automatically generates ZMK macros and a dedicated Emoji Layer.
# Features: 
#   1. Abstract Naming: Macros are named generically (e.g., &UC_PREFIX, &UC_winking_face).
#   2. Macro Chaining: Defines OS prefixes/suffixes once and chains them.
#   3. Custom Speeds: Uses UI-defined wait and tap times to prevent OS dropped keys.
#   4. Layer Builder: Safely pads with &trans so layer-toggles aren't broken.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# =========================================================================
# --- 1. CONFIGURATION & UNICODE DATA (USER EDITABLE) ---
# =========================================================================

# --- Color Palette ---

  { "name": "smiling_eyes",      "u": "1F60A",       "symb": "😊", "bg": $bg_faces },
