title: Switch between macOS and Windows
subtitle: Swap Ctrl and Cmd everywhere
description:
Swaps Ctrl and Cmd/GUI everywhere in your layout — including inside combinations like Ctrl+C — so Copy, Paste and Undo land on the same physical key on macOS and Windows.

Run it again any time to swap back — everything returns exactly as it was.

Optional: also trade Ctrl+Y for Cmd+Shift+Z, the macOS Redo. That option is not an exact swap if you also use Ctrl+Shift+Z, and the result tells you when that applies.
successMessage: Ctrl and Cmd/GUI have been swapped across every layer, including combinations like Ctrl+C — Copy, Paste and Undo now land on the same physical key on either system. Run it again to swap back.

title: Programmer punctuation
subtitle: Easier : and \" for coding
description:
Makes `:` and `"` easier to type when coding: swaps the Shifted and unshifted `;` and `'` — plus an optional double-tap on F4 to close windows.

⚠️ Needs tap-dance and mod-morph support in the Layout Editor. Each part is optional — turn any of them off.
successMessage: Semicolon/colon and quote keys now swap on Shift as you chose, and F4 double-tap now closes the active window if you enabled it. Each toggle is independent — re-run to change your mind on any one of them.

title: Symbols on the number row
subtitle: Symbol first, number on hold (Primeagen style)
description:
Type the symbol first and get the number on hold, double-tap or Shift — you choose which. Based on ThePrimeagen's number row. [How it's meant to work](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VzsxDbkV4rE&t=1150s).

⚠️ Needs tap-dance and mod-morph support in the Layout Editor, and replaces your base layer's number row. Pick **Restore Defaults** to undo it.
script:
# ==============================================================================
# 1. CORE UTILITIES & HARDWARE
# ==============================================================================

def GetHardware:
  (.keyboard | if type == "string" then ascii_downcase else "" end) as $kb |
  if $kb == "glove80" then
    { offset: 10, len: 12 } # Glove80 number row is keys 10 through 21
  elif $kb == "go60" then
    { offset: 0, len: 12 }  # Go60 number row is keys 0 through 11
  else
    error("This automation supports the Glove80 and Go60 only, and this file does not say which keyboard it is for.")
  end;

# ==============================================================================
# 2. BEHAVIOR DEFINITIONS (Strict AST Matching)
# ==============================================================================

def get_primeagen_holdtap: {
  "name": "&GLD_ht_primeagen",
  "description": "Primeagen NumRow Hold-Tap",
  "bindings": ["&kp", "&kp"],
  "tappingTermMs": 200,
  "flavor": "tap-preferred"
};

# Explicitly defined Mod-Morphs (12 definitions)
([
  { "name": "&GLD_mm_pr_0", "description": "Mod-Morph: + / @", "cases": [ { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "EQUAL"}]}] }, "mods": [], "keepMods": [] }, { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N2"}]}] }, "mods": ["MOD_LSFT", "MOD_RSFT"], "keepMods": [] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_mm_pr_1", "description": "Mod-Morph: ! / 1", "cases": [ { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N1"}]}] }, "mods": [], "keepMods": [] }, { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N1"}] }, "mods": ["MOD_LSFT", "MOD_RSFT"], "keepMods": [] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_mm_pr_2", "description": "Mod-Morph: [ / 2", "cases": [ { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LBKT"}] }, "mods": [], "keepMods": [] }, { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N2"}] }, "mods": ["MOD_LSFT", "MOD_RSFT"], "keepMods": [] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_mm_pr_3", "description": "Mod-Morph: { / 3", "cases": [ { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "LBKT"}]}] }, "mods": [], "keepMods": [] }, { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N3"}] }, "mods": ["MOD_LSFT", "MOD_RSFT"], "keepMods": [] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_mm_pr_4", "description": "Mod-Morph: ( / 4", "cases": [ { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N9"}]}] }, "mods": [], "keepMods": [] }, { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N4"}] }, "mods": ["MOD_LSFT", "MOD_RSFT"], "keepMods": [] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_mm_pr_5", "description": "Mod-Morph: & / 5", "cases": [ { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N7"}]}] }, "mods": [], "keepMods": [] }, { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N5"}] }, "mods": ["MOD_LSFT", "MOD_RSFT"], "keepMods": [] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_mm_pr_6", "description": "Mod-Morph: = / 6", "cases": [ { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "EQUAL"}] }, "mods": [], "keepMods": [] }, { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N6"}] }, "mods": ["MOD_LSFT", "MOD_RSFT"], "keepMods": [] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_mm_pr_7", "description": "Mod-Morph: ) / 7", "cases": [ { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N0"}]}] }, "mods": [], "keepMods": [] }, { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N7"}] }, "mods": ["MOD_LSFT", "MOD_RSFT"], "keepMods": [] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_mm_pr_8", "description": "Mod-Morph: } / 8", "cases": [ { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "RBKT"}]}] }, "mods": [], "keepMods": [] }, { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N8"}] }, "mods": ["MOD_LSFT", "MOD_RSFT"], "keepMods": [] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_mm_pr_9", "description": "Mod-Morph: ] / 9", "cases": [ { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "RBKT"}] }, "mods": [], "keepMods": [] }, { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N9"}] }, "mods": ["MOD_LSFT", "MOD_RSFT"], "keepMods": [] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_mm_pr_10", "description": "Mod-Morph: * / 0", "cases": [ { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N8"}]}] }, "mods": [], "keepMods": [] }, { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N0"}] }, "mods": ["MOD_LSFT", "MOD_RSFT"], "keepMods": [] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_mm_pr_11", "description": "Mod-Morph: $ / %", "cases": [ { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N4"}]}] }, "mods": [], "keepMods": [] }, { "binding": { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N5"}]}] }, "mods": ["MOD_LSFT", "MOD_RSFT"], "keepMods": [] } ] }
]) as $new_morphs |

# Explicitly defined Tap-Dances (12 definitions)
([
  { "name": "&GLD_td_pr_0", "description": "Tap-Dance: + / @", "tappingTermMs": 200, "bindings": [ { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "EQUAL"}]}] }, { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N2"}]}] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_td_pr_1", "description": "Tap-Dance: ! / 1", "tappingTermMs": 200, "bindings": [ { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N1"}]}] }, { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N1"}] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_td_pr_2", "description": "Tap-Dance: [ / 2", "tappingTermMs": 200, "bindings": [ { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LBKT"}] }, { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N2"}] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_td_pr_3", "description": "Tap-Dance: { / 3", "tappingTermMs": 200, "bindings": [ { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "LBKT"}]}] }, { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N3"}] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_td_pr_4", "description": "Tap-Dance: ( / 4", "tappingTermMs": 200, "bindings": [ { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N9"}]}] }, { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N4"}] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_td_pr_5", "description": "Tap-Dance: & / 5", "tappingTermMs": 200, "bindings": [ { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N7"}]}] }, { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N5"}] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_td_pr_6", "description": "Tap-Dance: = / 6", "tappingTermMs": 200, "bindings": [ { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "EQUAL"}] }, { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N6"}] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_td_pr_7", "description": "Tap-Dance: ) / 7", "tappingTermMs": 200, "bindings": [ { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N0"}]}] }, { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N7"}] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_td_pr_8", "description": "Tap-Dance: } / 8", "tappingTermMs": 200, "bindings": [ { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "RBKT"}]}] }, { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N8"}] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_td_pr_9", "description": "Tap-Dance: ] / 9", "tappingTermMs": 200, "bindings": [ { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "RBKT"}] }, { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N9"}] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_td_pr_10", "description": "Tap-Dance: * / 0", "tappingTermMs": 200, "bindings": [ { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N8"}]}] }, { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "N0"}] } ] },
  { "name": "&GLD_td_pr_11", "description": "Tap-Dance: $ / %", "tappingTermMs": 200, "bindings": [ { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N4"}]}] }, { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N5"}]}] } ] }
]) as $new_dances |

# Explicitly mapped parameters for the single Hold-Tap behavior
[
  [ {"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N2"}]}, {"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "EQUAL"}]} ],
  [ {"value": "N1"}, {"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N1"}]} ],
  [ {"value": "N2"}, {"value": "LBKT"} ],
  [ {"value": "N3"}, {"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "LBKT"}]} ],
  [ {"value": "N4"}, {"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N9"}]} ],
  [ {"value": "N5"}, {"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N7"}]} ],
  [ {"value": "N6"}, {"value": "EQUAL"} ],
  [ {"value": "N7"}, {"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N0"}]} ],
  [ {"value": "N8"}, {"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "RBKT"}]} ],
  [ {"value": "N9"}, {"value": "RBKT"} ],
  [ {"value": "N0"}, {"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N8"}]} ],
  [ {"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N4"}]}, {"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N5"}]} ]
] as $ht_params |

# Array 3: Defaults (for Restore option)
["EQUAL","N1","N2","N3","N4","N5","N6","N7","N8","N9","N0","MINUS"] as $arr_defaults |

# Array 4: Visual UI Labels for the keys (Symbol + Number)
["+ @", "! 1", "[ 2", "{ 3", "( 4", "& 5", "= 6", ") 7", "} 8", "] 9", "* 0", "$ %"] as $arr_labels |

(GetHardware) as $hw |

# The number row must exist on the base layer
(if ((.keymap // .).layers | type) != "array" or ((.keymap // .).layers[0] | length) < ($hw.offset + $hw.len)
 then error("The base layer is too short to hold a number row, so nothing was changed.")
 else . end) |

# What the layout holds before the change, to report what is new afterwards
(.keymap // .) as $before |

# ==============================================================================
# 3. MAIN TRANSFORMATION ENGINE
# ==============================================================================

(.keymap // .) |= (
  
  # Step 1: Safely inject ONLY the selected behaviors into the AST (Skipped on Restore)
  .holdTaps = (if $behavior_type == "hold-tap" then ((.holdTaps // []) + [get_primeagen_holdtap] | unique_by(.name)) else (.holdTaps // []) end) |
  .modMorphs = (if $behavior_type == "mod-morph" then ((.modMorphs // []) + $new_morphs | unique_by(.name)) else (.modMorphs // []) end) |
  .tapDances = (if $behavior_type == "tap-dance" then ((.tapDances // []) + $new_dances | unique_by(.name)) else (.tapDances // []) end) |

  # Step 2: Modify the Number Row on the Base Layer
  .layers[0] |= [
    range(length) as $i | .[$i] |
    
    # Check if the current key index is strictly inside the hardware's number row
    if ($i >= $hw.offset) and ($i < ($hw.offset + $hw.len)) then
      
      ($i - $hw.offset) as $idx | 

      # Safely extract existing decorations (like background color) to prevent overwriting them
      (if type == "object" and .decoration then .decoration else {} end) as $base_dec |
      
      # Safely inject or remove the specific 'label' property based on user selection
      ($base_dec | 
        if $behavior_type == "restore" or $add_labels == "no" then
          del(.label)
        else
          . + { "label": $arr_labels[$idx] }
        end
      ) as $new_dec |
      
      # Re-wrap into the decoration object if not empty
      (if $new_dec == {} then {} else { "decoration": $new_dec } end) as $dec_obj |
      
      if $behavior_type == "restore" then
        {
          value: "&kp",
          params: [{"value": $arr_defaults[$idx]}]
        } + $dec_obj
        
      elif $behavior_type == "hold-tap" then
        {
          value: "&GLD_ht_primeagen",
          params: $ht_params[$idx]
        } + $dec_obj
        
      elif $behavior_type == "tap-dance" then
        {
          value: ("&GLD_td_pr_" + ($idx | tostring))
        } + $dec_obj
        
      elif $behavior_type == "mod-morph" then
        {
          value: ("&GLD_mm_pr_" + ($idx | tostring))
        } + $dec_obj
        
      else 
        . 
      end

    else 
      . # Leave keys outside the number row completely untouched
    end
  ]
) |

# ==============================================================================
# 4. REPORT
# ==============================================================================

(.keymap // .) as $after |
({"hold-tap": ["holdTaps", "hold-tap"], "tap-dance": ["tapDances", "tap-dances"], "mod-morph": ["modMorphs", "mod-morphs"]}[$behavior_type]) as $kind |
([range($hw.offset; $hw.offset + $hw.len) | select($before.layers[0][.] != $after.layers[0][.])] | length) as $keys |
(if $kind == null then 0
 else [($after[$kind[0]] // [])[].name | select(. as $n | [($before[$kind[0]] // [])[].name] | index($n) | not)] | length end) as $added |
if $keys == 0 and $added == 0 then
  . + {_flowReport: {changed: false, message: "Nothing was changed: your number row already is set up this way.", lines: [], log: ["\($behavior_type): no key differs, no behavior is new"]}}
else
  . + {_flowReport: {
      changed: true,
      lines: ([{ok: true, text: (if $behavior_type == "restore"
                                 then "Put the standard number row back on the base layer (\($keys) keys changed)"
                                 else "Number row on the base layer now uses \($kind[1]) (\($keys) keys changed)" end)}]
              + (if $kind == null then []
                 else [{ok: true, text: (if $added > 0 then "Added \($added) \($kind[1])" else "Your \($kind[1]) from an earlier run were reused" end)}] end)
              + (if $behavior_type != "restore" and $add_labels == "yes" then [{ok: true, text: "Labeled the keys with their symbol and number"}] else [] end)),
      log: ["\($behavior_type), labels \($add_labels), keys \($hw.offset + 1) to \($hw.offset + $hw.len), \($keys) changed, \($added) new behaviors"]
    }}
end
successMessage: Your number row now behaves the way you chose — tap for symbol with the number on hold, double-tap, or shift — or back to the factory row if you picked Restore Defaults.

param.label: When to give the number
labels: Hold-Tap (Tap for Symbol, Hold for Number)
Tap-Dance (Tap for Symbol, Double-Tap for Number)
Shift for Numbers (Tap for Symbol, Shift for Number)

title: Symbol layer: German

description:
Makes your **Symbol** layer type the right characters when your computer's keyboard language is German (de-DE).

⚠️ Add the **Symbol layer** automation first — this one needs it. (These mappings are generated automatically, not hand-verified — flag it if something looks wrong.)
script:

# ==============================================================================

{
  # --- Punctuation & Basics ---

  "LS(N1)":              [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N1", "params": []}]}],            
  "AT":                  [{"value": "RA", "params": [{"value": "Q", "params": []}]}],             # @ -> AltGr + Q

  "LS(N7)":              [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "N6", "params": []}]}],            
  "STAR":                [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "RBKT", "params": []}]}],          # * -> Shift + +
  "LS(N8)":              [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "RBKT", "params": []}]}],          
  "TILDE":               [{"value": "RA", "params": [{"value": "RBKT", "params": []}]}],          # ~ -> AltGr + +
  "LS(GRAVE)":           [{"value": "RA", "params": [{"value": "RBKT", "params": []}]}],          
  "QMARK":               [{"value": "LS", "params": [{"value": "MINUS", "params": []}]}],         # ? -> Shift + ß

# ==============================================================================
# 15 SMART KEYS
# ==============================================================================
# Adds 29 behaviors (4 macros, 10 mod-morphs, 11 tap-dances, 4 hold-taps). With

#
# It stops, and changes nothing, when the file has no layers or the two layers do
# not fit within the 32 allowed. A behavior with the same name as one of these is
# replaced by the new one (the report says how many); everything else is kept.
# ==============================================================================

def MAX_LAYERS: 32;

# Puts the new items in the list; an item with the same name is replaced, the others stay in place.
def put_all($new):
  (. // []) as $have
  | ($have | map(select(.name as $n | ($new | map(.name) | index($n)) == null))) + $new;

# The layout as it is now, to tell afterwards what changed.
(if type == "object" and .keymap? then .keymap else . end) as $before |

# --- STEP 0: CHECKS, AND THE NAV / NUM LAYERS THE NEW KEYS SWITCH TO ---

   else . end) |
  (if $auto_bind == "yes" then
    ((.layer_names // []) as $names

     else . end) |
    (.layers[0] | length) as $layer_size |
    reduce $missing[] as $name (.;
      .layer_names += [$name] |

  { "name": "&td_math_logic", "description": "14. Math & Logic Operator", "tappingTermMs": 200, "bindings": [ { "value": "&mm_eq_plus", "params": [] }, { "value": "&mac_fat_arrow", "params": [] } ] },
  { "name": "&td_power_screen", "description": "15. OS Power & Screenshot Key", "tappingTermMs": 200, "bindings": [ { "value": "&mm_pscrn_snip", "params": [] }, { "value": "&kp", "params": [{"value": "C_SLEEP", "params": []}] } ] }
]) as $new_dances |

# --- D. HOLD-TAPS (Pure Hold-Taps, Quick-Tap enabled) ---
([
  { "name": "&ht_thumb_bspc", "description": "1. God-Tier Thumb Backspace", "bindings": [ "&mo", "&mm_bspc_del" ], "tappingTermMs": 200, "flavor": "tap-preferred" },
  { "name": "&ht_hrm_safe", "description": "5. Safe HRM Escape (Generic)", "bindings": [ "&kp", "&kp" ], "tappingTermMs": 200, "requirePriorIdleMs": 150, "quickTapMs": 200, "flavor": "tap-preferred" },
  { "name": "&ht_ctrl_esc", "description": "6. 40% Smart Escape Corner", "bindings": [ "&kp", "&mm_esc_tilde" ], "tappingTermMs": 200, "flavor": "tap-preferred" },
  { "name": "&ht_alt_tab", "description": "8. App Switcher Engine", "bindings": [ "&kp", "&mm_tab_bck" ], "tappingTermMs": 200, "flavor": "tap-preferred" }
]) as $new_holds |

(.keymap // .) |= (
  .macros    = ((.macros // [])    | put_all($new_macros)) |
  .modMorphs = ((.modMorphs // []) | put_all($new_morphs)) |
  .tapDances = ((.tapDances // []) | put_all($new_dances)) |
  .holdTaps  = ((.holdTaps // [])  | put_all($new_holds)) |

  # ==============================================================================
  # STEP 2: AUTO-ASSIGN ON BASE LAYER (Strict Tap-Dance routing)
  # ==============================================================================
  (if $auto_bind == "yes" then
    {
      "BSPC":     {"value": "&ht_thumb_bspc", "params": [{"value": $idx_nav}]},
      "SPACE":    {"value": "&td_spc_tog"},
      "RET":      {"value": "&td_enter_eol"},
      "DOT":      {"value": "&td_punct_power"},
      "LBKT":     {"value": "&td_nested_brackets"},
      "FSLH":     {"value": "&td_quest_excl"},
      "MINUS":    {"value": "&td_dash_arrow"},
      "EQUAL":    {"value": "&td_math_logic"},
      "ESC":      {"value": "&ht_ctrl_esc", "params": [{"value": "LCTRL", "params": []}]},
      "TAB":      {"value": "&ht_alt_tab", "params": [{"value": "LALT", "params": []}]},
      "C_VOL_UP": {"value": "&td_media"},
      "PSCRN":    {"value": "&td_power_screen"},
      "LSHFT":    {"value": "&td_caps_word"}
    } as $map |

    .layers[0] |= map(
      if type == "object" and .value == "&kp" and .params and (.params | length > 0) and (.params[0].value | in($map)) then
        $map[.params[0].value] + (if .decoration then {decoration: .decoration} else {} end)
      else
        .
      end
    )
  else . end)
)

# --- REPORT ---
| (if type == "object" and .keymap? then .keymap else . end) as $after
| ($new_macros + $new_morphs + $new_dances + $new_holds | map(.name)) as $names
| ([$before.macros, $before.modMorphs, $before.tapDances, $before.holdTaps | (. // [])[] | select(.name as $n | $names | index($n))] | length) as $replaced
| ([range(0; ($before.layers[0] | length)) as $i | select($before.layers[0][$i] != $after.layers[0][$i])] | length) as $upgraded
| (["Nav", "Num"] | map(select(. as $n | (($before.layer_names // []) | index($n)) == null and (($after.layer_names // []) | index($n)) != null))) as $newLayers
| (["Nav", "Num"] | map(select(. as $n | (($after.layer_names // []) | index($n)) == null))) as $noLayers
| if $before == $after then
    . + {_flowReport: {changed: false, message: "Nothing was changed: the smart keys are already in your layout.", lines: [], log: ["identical to the existing behaviors"]}}
  else
    . + {_flowReport: {
        changed: true,
        lines: ([{ok: true, text: "Added \($names | length) smart-key behaviors\(if $replaced > 0 then " (\($replaced) with the same name were replaced)" else "" end)"}]
                + (if $auto_bind != "yes" then [] elif $upgraded > 0 then [{ok: true, text: "Upgraded \($upgraded) keys on your first layer"}] else [{ok: false, text: "None of the keys on your first layer matched, so assign the new behaviors to keys yourself."}] end)
                + (if ($newLayers | length) > 0 then [{ok: true, text: "Added the empty \($newLayers | join(" and ")) layer\(if ($newLayers | length) > 1 then "s" else "" end) that the new keys switch to"}] else [] end)
                + (if $auto_bind != "yes" and ($noLayers | length) > 0 then [{ok: false, text: "Your layout has no \($noLayers | join(" or ")) layer, so the new Backspace and Space keys point at layers \($idx_nav + 1) and \($idx_num + 1) by number. Check where those lead before you use them."}] else [] end)),
        log: ["replaced: \($replaced), upgraded keys: \($upgraded), new layers: \($newLayers | join(", "))"]
      }}
  end
